name: @arena/webhook-delivery
description: Arena signed webhook delivery service (Work Order P003; issue #155; ADR-P001-08 rule 4 — at-least-once signed delivery of the closed 13-type taxonomy, deduped per EVENT ID never per type; ADR-P001-01 — job-driven dispatch where the host provides it). Drains the P002 durable webhook outbox (the frozen @arena/runtime-host WebhookOutboxPort) through the existing adapters/escalation WebhookDeliveryAdapter contract (HMAC-SHA256, x-arena-signature, x-arena-event-id, deterministic backoff retry, explicit dead-letter) over a real node fetch transport. DISCLOSED: the frozen host job-kind registry is closed (no webhook-delivery kind is registrable without editing the frozen P002 package), so dispatch rides a dedicated durable loop — the outbox is the durable substrate (listPending/markDelivered over Postgres); the attempt ledger + dead-letter lot are process-local (a restart re-arms pending events from the durable outbox — at-least-once holds; dead-letter permanence across restart is the disclosed limitation).
